map.计算凯撒密码加密后字母的位置偏移量（用于演示）。: Shift English letters by 0-25 to demonstrate the Caesar cipher, for teaching classical substitution ciphers.
map.📖 查看「凯撒密码移位 使用指南」: 📖 View the Caesar Cipher Shift Guide
map.仅演示字母位置计算，不含完整加解密。: Demonstrates letter-position math only; no full encrypt/decrypt.
map.密码学教学：直观展示单表替换与循环移位原理。: Cryptography teaching: Visually show single-table substitution and cyclic shifting.
map.谜题/游戏：快速生成或破解简单移位密文。: Puzzles/games: Quickly generate or crack simple shift ciphertext.
map.概念演示：说明密钥空间仅 25 种、极易暴力枚举的弱点。: Concept demo: Show the weakness that the key space is only 25 and easily brute-forced.
map.H→K,E→H,L→O,L→O,O→R → \"KHOOR\"；移位 0 或 2: H to K, E to H, L to O, L to O, O to R -> "KHOOR"; shift 0 or 26 gives plaintext.
map.不安全，密钥空间仅 25 种，穷举即可破解，仅用于教学。: No. The key space is only 25, so brute force cracks it; for teaching only.
map.通常保留空格/标点/数字不变，仅对 A–Z/a–z 循环移位。: Spaces, punctuation, and digits are usually kept unchanged; only A-Z/a-z shift cyclically.
